newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real ends flat at 1.0615 per dollar.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real ends flat at 1.0615 per dollar.

text.p: Brazil's real ended steady at 1.0615 reais per dollar in a commercial foreign exchange market still short of dollars, dealers said.

The Central bank sold dollars at 1.0615 reais per greenback in the afternoon to increase liquidity and maintain the dollar within the current mini-band of between 1.0565 and 1.0615 reais per dollar, they added.
In the interbank foreign exchange floating rate market, the real ended unchanged at 1.0619 reais per dollar.
In the illegal parallel market, the real closed flat at 1.100 reais per greenback.
